templates.source: Y10 Higher Spring B4 Rounding and estimation · S4 Upper and lower bounds
templates.text: A length is [[x]] cm to 1 decimal place. Write the lower and upper bounds.
templates.answer: Lower bound [[x - 0.05]] cm; upper bound [[x + 0.05]] cm

templates.source: Y10 Higher Spring B4 Rounding and estimation · S4 Upper and lower bounds
templates.text: A rectangle is [[a]] cm by [[b]] cm, each to the nearest cm. Work out the upper bound for its area.

templates.source: Y10 Higher Spring B4 Rounding and estimation · S4 Upper and lower bounds
templates.text: $a = [[a]]$ and $b = [[b]]$ both to the nearest integer. Work out the lower bound of $a - b$ and the upper bound of $\frac{a}{b}$.
templates.answer: Lower bound of $a - b$ = [[a - 0.5 - (b + 0.5)]]; upper bound of $\frac{a}{b}$ = [[(a + 0.5) / (b - 0.5)|dp:2]]

templates.source: Y10 Higher Spring B4 Rounding and estimation · S4 Upper and lower bounds
templates.text: A car travels [[d]] km (to the nearest km) in [[t]] hours (to the nearest hour). Work out the upper bound and lower bound for its average speed. (4 marks)
templates.answer: Upper bound [[(d + 0.5) / (t - 0.5)|dp:2]] km/h; lower bound [[(d - 0.5) / (t + 0.5)|dp:2]] km/h

templates.source: Y10 Higher Spring B4 Rounding and estimation · S5 Error intervals (including truncation)
templates.text: A plank is [[n / 10]] m long to 1 decimal place. (a) Write the error interval. (b) Could the length be [[n / 10 + 0.05]] m? Explain. (3 marks)
templates.answer: (a) $[[n / 10 - 0.05]] \leq x < [[n / 10 + 0.05]]$  (b) No: the upper limit is not included
